# The Fantasy Arsenal

> The Fantasy Arsenal is a web application for managing and analyzing Sleeper fantasy football leagues. It provides league-aware tools for trades, player exposure, live drafts, lineups, waivers, rankings, schedules, and manager research.

Canonical site: https://thefantasyarsenal.com/

The canonical pages below contain crawlable summaries and visible FAQs. Use those pages as the primary citation targets rather than account, query-string, or embedded Ballsville URLs.

## Primary tools

- [Fantasy Football Trade Calculator](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/trade): Analyze dynasty and redraft trades with multiple value sources and optional Sleeper league, roster, scoring, and format context.
- [Player Stock and Exposure Tracker](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/player-stock/results): See player exposure across a Sleeper portfolio, including roster shares, draft shares, ADP, values, projections, and source movement.
- [Live Sleeper Draft Monitor](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/draft-pick-tracker): Monitor multiple active Sleeper drafts, on-clock and on-deck status, recent picks, and estimated time until the user's next pick.
- [Sleeper League Hub](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/league-hub): Review multi-league transactions, free-agent opportunities, injuries, player availability, and bye-week or lineup conflicts.

## Additional tools

- [Lineup Optimizer](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/lineup)
- [Power Rankings](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/power-rankings)
- [Player Availability](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/player-availability)
- [Strength of Schedule](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/sos)
- [League History](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/league-history)
- [Trust and Accuracy](https://thefantasyarsenal.com/trust-center)

## Terminology

- "Player Stock" is the site's player exposure and portfolio-tracking tool.
- "Draft Monitor" is the site's live multi-draft tracker for Sleeper.
- "League Hub" is the site's multi-league Sleeper manager dashboard.
- Source values and projections are attributed in the application; they are not official Sleeper rankings.
